author: Top Gear
description:
In this video Top Gear drives the new Brabus Bodo. It’s the most expensive Brabus ever, costing £1m, and also one of the most powerful Brabus models ever, with 1000hp from its twin-turbo V12. But deep beneath the bespoke carbonfibre body and overhauled chassis lies the bones of an Aston Martin Vanquish, so has Brabus improved upon that British super GT, or ruined it?
